displayName: Survival Workyard U4 Waterworks Dock and Bucket Pulley
gameplayRole: The waterworks lesson: an L-shaped pond dock from the Workyard shore toward the adjacent bank carrying the bucket-pulley station and the reserved U5 fishing edge

reference.provenance: Original Crafted Realm concepts generated with Gemini / Nano Banana 2 on 2026-07-15

visibleFeatures: unmistakable two-tile-wide L: shore span, corner work platform with turned decking, bank span, with a 1.8-tile clear cardinal lane
36 individually hand-cut planks with jittered profiles, honest gaps, repaired boards, and two structural junction sills
16 driven tapered piles with dark waterline sleeves, proud iron-banded corner bollards, bearers, and crossed below-deck braces
sagging rope-and-post rails on outer edges only — shore entry, bank exit, corner work area, and fishing edge stay open
stone footings and threshold beams at both shore contacts
pegged pulley frame with back braces, iron foot brackets, crossbeam, jib with guide wheel, winch drum with rope wraps and flanges, outboard crank with worn grip
taut fall rope to an iron hook engaging the arched bail of a staved lesson bucket with two iron hoops and a genuinely recessed interior
cantilevered set-down ledge beside (never under) the bucket's drop line
pivot: family root at the shore-entry walking surface; deck top is local z 0, assumed water plane local z -0.50
facing: the dock leaves the shore toward Blender +X (exported Three.js -X) and turns right toward the bank at Blender -Y (exported Three.js -Z rear); front is Blender -Y and exported Three.js +Z

placement.room: holm_survival_workyard pond, from u4_waterworks_shore_socket at Workyard-local (9.92, 1.85, 0.20)
placement.rule: root pivot lands on the socket; Codex adjusts after eyes-on terrain review of the pond bed and adjacent bank

interactionOwner: Codex — live Operate/Inspect, Blender clip playback, splash/audio, atomic bucket swap, interruption, and save ledger in src/workyard_waterworks_u4.js
collisionOwner: Codex — three walkable deck surfaces plus one service blocker; piles, braces, rails, ropes, bucket travel, and sockets remain non-colliding

cardinalTurnaround.evidence: three 4-view cardinal sets (shell, raised, lowered water-contact) plus a five-moment motion strip, each with written per-direction/per-pose PASS-FAIL reviews in scratchpad/workyard_waterworks_u4_v1 (turnaround_*, motion_*)
cardinalTurnaround.verdict: PASS 12/12 cardinal views and 5/5 motion poses after seven authored corrections logged in the reviews

humanScaleRevision.rule: Every working surface serves the 1.85-tile adventurer; the frame stays a working station, never a crane
